reviewMethod: Antigravity drafts separately reviewed against complete archived version bodies and source notes; source discrepancies retained explicitly.

headings.title: Recording, filing, and general corporate powers
headings.reviewNote: Requires recording articles in county and filing with secretary of state, conferring corporate status and operational and leasing powers.

headings.title: Certified articles as evidence and capital stock changes
headings.reviewNote: Establishes certified articles as prima facie evidence of incorporation and authorizes board to increase or decrease capital stock with shareholder consent.

headings.title: Amendment referencing operating designation under federal tax code
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes corporations to amend articles to reference operating designation described in 26 U.S.C. Section 501(c)(12).

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5322, A.L. 2020 H.B. 1768). Confirmed draft titles for articles recording/filing, certified copy evidence/capital changes, and 26 U.S.C. § 501(c)(12) amendment.

headings.title: Annual election, terms, and notice for directors
headings.reviewNote: Requires annual election of directors for one-year terms upon at least twenty days published newspaper notice in county of principal office.

headings.title: Election of president and appointment of officers
headings.reviewNote: Directs directors to elect a president from their number and authorizes appointment of officers and agents per articles or bylaws.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5323; § 351.267 cross-ref). Confirmed draft titles for annual director elections with 20-day newspaper notice and president/officer appointments.

headings.title: Application of statutory definitions
headings.reviewNote: Applies definitions from section 386.020 to words and phrases used in this section.

headings.title: Live operator access requirement for operator services
headings.reviewNote: Requires telecommunications companies providing operator services to enable caller access to a live operator at call inception.

headings.title: Exemption for correctional and detention facility telephones
headings.reviewNote: Exempts telephones located in correctional or detention facilities from live operator access requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 1997 S.B. 333 § 1). Confirmed draft titles for § 386.020 definitions, live operator access at call start, and correctional/detention facility exemption.

headings.title: Adequate facilities and just and reasonable charges
headings.reviewNote: Mandates just and reasonable facilities and rates, declaring unjust or unreasonable charges unlawful.

headings.title: Prohibition against rate discrimination, rebates, and special rates
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits special rates, rebates, and discrimination while authorizing approved promotional programs, economy rates, and FCC Lifeline tariffs; source notes cite Videon Corp. (1963) and DePaul Hospital (1976).

headings.title: Prohibition against unreasonable preferences and message classifications
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits undue preferences or disadvantages to persons or localities, permitting reasonable classification of messages and rates.

headings.title: Geographic rate uniformity, market segmentation, and competitive tariffs
headings.reviewNote: Regulates service differentiation by geography or market segment, setting review standards, burden of proof, cost floors, and commission authority.

headings.title: Distance-based pricing uniformity for interexchange services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits charging different rates for equivalent distance without approved tariff, while permitting nondiscriminatory volume discounts.

headings.title: Nondiscriminatory message transmission for interconnected carriers
headings.reviewNote: Requires every company to receive, transmit, and deliver conversations and messages of connected companies without discrimination or delay.

headings.title: Commission authority to establish free delivery limits
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to set limits within which telecommunications messages must be delivered without extra charge.

headings.title: Authorization of customer-specific pricing
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes customer-specific pricing on equal basis for private line, special access, PBX substitutes, and business services in competitive exchanges.

headings.title: Commission authority to alter local exchange boundaries
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to alter exchange boundaries in public interest upon notice of approval from serving incumbent local exchange carriers.

headings.title: Authorization of term agreements up to five years
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes telecommunications companies to offer term agreements of up to five years on any telecommunications services.

headings.title: Discounted rates and special promotions for customers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes companies to offer discounted rates or special promotions to existing, new, or former customers.

headings.title: Exemption of packaged services from certain regulations
headings.reviewNote: Exempts service packages from rate regulation and geographic restrictions provided bundled components remain separately available, requiring informational filings.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 12 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5664 through A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779; §§ 77.490, 386.320 cross-refs; Videon Corp. 1963 and DePaul Hospital 1976 annotations). Confirmed all 12 draft titles.

headings.title: Prohibition on incumbent intrastate electronic publishing
headings.reviewNote: Prohibited incumbent local exchange companies from providing intrastate electronic publishing over company facilities prior to February 7, 2000.

headings.title: Adoption of federal electronic publishing standards
headings.reviewNote: Incorporated Section 274 of the federal Telecommunications Act of 1996 to govern intrastate electronic publishing until February 7, 2000.

headings.title: Commission jurisdiction over electronic publishing provisions
headings.reviewNote: Granted public service commission primary and concurrent jurisdiction to administer electronic publishing provisions consistent with federal law.

headings.title: Exemption for public internet and community bulletin boards
headings.reviewNote: Exempted internet services and electronic bulletin boards offered primarily as community or public services from electronic publishing restrictions.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (L. 1996 S.B. 507). Confirmed all 4 draft titles covering pre-Feb. 7, 2000 electronic publishing restrictions, federal § 274 adoption, commission jurisdiction, and public internet exemption.

headings.title: Annual reports, verification, penalties, and exemptions
headings.reviewNote: Mandates verified annual reports following FCC forms, provides daily forfeiture for default, and authorizes commission exemptions.

headings.title: Prescription of accounting systems, inspection, and confidentiality
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to establish accounting systems and examine records, making unauthorized disclosure of inspection information a misdemeanor.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5668, A.L. 1984 H.B. 1477, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed draft titles for verified annual reports/$100 daily forfeiture and accounting systems/inspection confidentiality.

headings.title: Printing and filing of rate schedules and contracts
headings.reviewNote: Requires printing, filing, and public inspection of rate schedules and joint rates, empowering commission to prescribe schedule forms and contract filings; source notes cite City of West Plains (1958) and Warner (1968).

headings.title: Thirty days notice for rate changes and strict schedule adherence
headings.reviewNote: Mandates thirty days notice for rate changes, prohibits rate discrimination or unfiled concessions, and exempts cooperative local exchange rates.

headings.title: Prohibition against free or reduced-rate service and exceptions
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits free passes or reduced rates except for employees, charities, ministers, other utilities, schools, libraries, and government contracts.

headings.title: Classification and thirty-day suspension of new service rates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes suspension of new service tariffs for up to thirty days, setting classification procedures for noncompetitive and competitive offerings.

headings.title: Informational filing requirement for telephone cooperative rate changes
headings.reviewNote: Requires telephone cooperatives to file rate changes thirty days in advance on informational basis, disclaiming commission local rate jurisdiction.

headings.title: Penalties and certificate revocation for rate violations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to revoke service certificates and seek court penalties up to treble revenue or gross operating revenues for rate violations.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5665 through A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779; City of West Plains 1958 and Warner 1968 annotations). Confirmed all 6 draft titles.

headings.title: Long and short haul rate restriction for interexchange services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits higher charges for shorter than longer distances over same line or through rates exceeding aggregate intermediate rates.

headings.title: Commission relief from long and short haul restriction
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission upon application and investigation to grant relief from long and short haul restrictions in special cases.

headings.title: Commission rate hearings and suspension periods for general utilities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to suspend new rate schedules for up to sixty days, with discretionary extension up to ninety additional days.

headings.title: Definition of small telephone company
headings.reviewNote: Defines small telephone company as a local exchange carrier serving no more than 25,000 subscriber access lines in Missouri.

headings.title: Rate filing, customer notice, and suspension for small telephone companies
headings.reviewNote: Requires thirty days advance customer notice and authorizes up to 150-day suspension period for small telephone company rate filings.

headings.title: Burden of proof and priority for rate increase proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Places burden of proof on utility to justify rate increases and requires commission to give rate increase proceedings priority.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5671, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360, A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779). Confirmed all 6 draft titles covering long/short haul restrictions, suspension periods, small telephone companies (<=25,000 lines), and burden of proof.

headings.title: Commission determination and ordering of just and reasonable rates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission after hearing to fix maximum just and reasonable rates considering property value, return, and necessary surplus; source note cites General Telephone Co. (1976).

headings.title: Commission orders regarding adequate equipment, regulations, and practices
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to prescribe adequate regulations, equipment, and service standards to be observed by telecommunications companies.

headings.title: Mandatory physical connection and joint rates between companies
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to require physical line connections and establish through lines, joint rates, and cost apportionments between companies.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5670, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360; General Telephone Co. 1976 annotation). Confirmed draft titles for maximum rate fixing, adequate service orders, and mandatory physical connections.

headings.title: Price cap regulation authority and lawful price standard
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to employ price cap regulation, establishing that prices within maximum allowable limits are deemed just, reasonable, and lawful.

headings.title: Applicability and election of price cap regulation
headings.reviewNote: Mandates price cap regulation for large incumbents upon competitor entry and permits small incumbents to elect price cap regulation.

headings.title: Baseline date for maximum allowable prices
headings.reviewNote: Establishes December 31 of preceding year as baseline for maximum allowable prices, with phase-in for authorized rebalancing tariffs.

headings.title: Annual CPI adjustment, waiver, and local rate caps
headings.reviewNote: Regulates annual CPI adjustments to maximum allowable prices, waiver procedures for negative CPI, and rate increases in noncompetitive exchanges.

headings.title: Competitive classification standards, procedures, and service rule waivers
headings.reviewNote: Establishes criteria and procedures for classifying exchanges as competitive, deregulating billing and engineering rules, and emergency commission powers.

headings.title: Preservation of commission jurisdiction over noncompetitive services
headings.reviewNote: Preserves commission jurisdiction over quality, conditions, and minimum service standards for noncompetitive telecommunications services.

headings.title: Exemption from traditional rate-of-return regulation
headings.reviewNote: Exempts companies regulated under price cap provisions from traditional rate determination under section 392.240.1.

headings.title: Reduction of intrastate access rates toward interstate levels
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes incumbents to reduce intrastate access rates to not exceed 150% of interstate access rates, or lower.

headings.title: Basic local rate offset for access service revenue losses
headings.reviewNote: Permits offsetting access revenue reductions through annual basic local rate increases up to $1.50 per month, subject to toll reductions.

headings.title: Mandatory flow-through of access cost reductions to toll rates
headings.reviewNote: Requires carriers receiving intrastate access cost reductions to decrease intrastate toll rates to pass savings to customers.

headings.title: Exemption of nonbasic telecommunications services from price caps
headings.reviewNote: Exempts all nonbasic telecommunications services of price-cap regulated incumbents from maximum allowable price limitations.

headings.title: Company discretion in setting intrastate depreciation rates
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes price-cap incumbents to determine own depreciation rates for intrastate purposes without binding universal service fund determinations.

headings.title: Statewide average rate studies and legislative reports
headings.reviewNote: Directed commission to conduct studies of nonwireless basic local rates in 2005, 2008, and 2011 and report findings to general assembly.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 13 subsections and source notes (L. 1996 S.B. 507 through A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779). Confirmed all 13 draft titles covering price cap regulation, CPI adjustments, competitive classification, access rebalancing, nonbasic exemption, depreciation, and 2005–2011 rate studies.

headings.title: Creation and administration of universal service board and fund
headings.reviewNote: Establishes Universal Service Board and fund, independent administrator, open meetings, and annual independent audit requirements.

headings.title: Permissible uses of universal service fund moneys
headings.reviewNote: Restricts fund disbursements to high-cost area support, low-income and disabled customer discounts, and reasonable administrative costs.

headings.title: Funding assessments on telecommunications companies and price cap recovery
headings.reviewNote: Funds universal service through revenue assessments, allowing price-cap companies to recover 50% via nonbasic or access rates and 50% via fund requirements.

headings.title: Eligibility criteria for high-cost and low-income support
headings.reviewNote: Conditions high-cost support on carrier of last resort duties and facilities, and low-income support on providing discounted service.

headings.title: Carrier of last resort designations in competitive and noncompetitive areas
headings.reviewNote: Designates incumbents as carrier of last resort, authorizing commission to designate additional carriers or allow relinquishment.

headings.title: Commission duties in defining essential services and setting support
headings.reviewNote: Directs commission to define essential services, identify qualifying high-cost areas, determine support payments, and establish eligibility standards.

headings.title: Initial organizational meeting of universal service board
headings.reviewNote: Directs commission to arrange time and place for initial organizational meeting of universal service board.

headings.title: Universal service board plan of operation
headings.reviewNote: Requires board to submit plan of operation for commission approval detailing asset handling, accounting, and assessment collections.

headings.title: Contractual and litigation authority of universal service board
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes universal service board to enter into contracts and sue or be sued, including actions to recover unpaid assessments.

headings.title: Civil immunity for universal service board members
headings.reviewNote: Immunizes board members from civil liability for performing statutory duties absent intentional or reckless conduct.

headings.title: Consistency with federal universal service laws and rules
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that no action shall be required that is inconsistent with federal statutes, rules, or judicial decisions.

headings.title: General implementation authority for commission and board
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission and board to take all necessary and convenient actions to implement and administer universal service fund.

headings.title: Rate or fund adjustment upon federal universal service revenue changes
headings.reviewNote: Mandated price cap or state USF adjustments to offset FCC-ordered federal USF revenue changes announced by Dec. 31, 1997; footnote notes original rolls contain 'subdivision 3 of subsection 6'.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 13 subsections and source notes (L. 1996 S.B. 507; original-rolls footnote on sub 13). Confirmed all 13 draft titles for Universal Service Board/Fund creation, assessments, COLR designations, immunity, and 1997 federal USF offsets.

headings.title: Commission valuation and revaluation authority for company property
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to ascertain property values, make revaluations, and assess new construction, extensions, and additions.

headings.title: Valuation hearing procedure, evidentiary effect, and supplemental findings
headings.reviewNote: Establishes notice, hearing, and review procedures for property valuations, making certified findings conclusive evidence absent changed conditions.

headings.title: Reliance on original cost in rate proceedings
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to rely on original cost evidence rather than fair value in determining just and reasonable rates.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5679, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360; § 386.330 cross-ref). Confirmed draft titles for property valuation/revaluation, hearing/evidentiary effect, and original-cost reliance.

headings.title: Prescription of depreciation accounts and rate determination
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to require depreciation accounts and fix depreciation rates, requiring utility justification and twelve-month decision timeline.

headings.title: Authorization and ratemaking treatment of minimum depreciation rates
headings.reviewNote: Permits authorization of minimum depreciation rates, requiring test-period depreciation calculations based on minimum rates regardless of recorded expense.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5680, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360, A.L. 1993 S.B. 160). Confirmed draft titles for depreciation accounts/12-month ruling and minimum depreciation rates.

headings.title: State supervision of securities issuance and property liens
headings.reviewNote: Declares issuance of securities and creation of liens a special privilege subject to state regulation and commission rules.

headings.title: Exemption for multistate telecommunications companies
headings.reviewNote: Exempts companies operating in Missouri and other states from commission authorization for issuing securities or encumbering systems.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5674, A.L. 1986 S.B. 625, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed draft titles for state supervision of securities/liens and multistate company exemption.

headings.title: Approval required for property transfers, mergers, and tax impact filings
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission approval for system transfers, encumbrances, or mergers, mandating local tax impact statements sent to county clerks.

headings.title: Ten percent stock acquisition restriction for non-telecommunications corporations
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits non-telecommunications corporations from acquiring over ten percent of company stock without commission consent, voiding unauthorized transfers.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5675, A.L. 1984 H.B. 1477, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed draft titles for transfer/merger approval with local tax impact filings and 10% non-telecom stock acquisition limit.

headings.title: Commission authorization for long-term indebtedness and expenditure purposes
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuance of securities exceeding twelve months for property acquisition, construction, refunding, or reimbursement under commission order.

headings.title: Order terms and non-chargeability to operating expenses
headings.reviewNote: Requires commission orders to fix issue amounts and purposes, certifying proceeds are reasonably required and not chargeable to operating expenses.

headings.title: Commission investigation and hearing procedures
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to conduct inquiries, investigations, hearings, and examinations to determine whether to authorize securities issues.

headings.title: Application of proceeds and short-term note issuance
headings.reviewNote: Restricts proceeds to specified purposes, authorizes twelve-month notes without approval, and prohibits unapproved long-term refunding.

headings.title: Limitation on necessity of applying for security issuance authority
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that applications are only required for property acquisition, construction, service improvements, refunding, or expenditure reimbursement.

headings.title: Prohibition against capitalization of franchises, contracts, or mergers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits capitalizing franchises, incorporation rights, or merger contracts, capping consolidated stock at par value and paid-in cash.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 6 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5676, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed all 6 draft titles covering long-term security authorization, order terms, investigations, 12-month notes, scope limits, and franchise/merger capitalization ban.

headings.title: Commission certificate required prior to security issuance or payment receipt
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits issuing securities or receiving consideration until commission certificate of authorization is recorded on corporate books.

headings.title: Commission authorization required for stock, bond, or scrip dividends
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits declaring stock, bond, or scrip dividends or distributing proceeds to stockholders without commission authorization.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5677, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed draft titles for recording commission certificate before security issuance and approval for stock/bond/scrip dividends.

headings.title: Accounting for security sales proceeds and rulemaking authority
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to require accounting of securities proceeds and adopt rules pursuant to section 536.024.

headings.title: Invalidity of unauthorized securities and protection of bona fide holders
headings.reviewNote: Declares unauthorized or nonconforming securities void, protecting bona fide purchasers for value without actual notice.

headings.title: Corporate penalties for unauthorized security issuance or misapplication
headings.reviewNote: Imposes fines of $500 to $20,000 per offense on companies issuing unauthorized securities or misapplying proceeds.

headings.title: Criminal penalties for officers, agents, and individuals
headings.reviewNote: Makes unauthorized security issuance, false statements to commission, or proceeds diversion a felony punishable by fine and imprisonment.

headings.title: Disclaimer of state obligation or guarantee for securities
headings.reviewNote: Provides that no statutory provision or authorized security issuance shall obligate or bind the state of Missouri as guarantor.

headings.title: Invalidity of securities authorized under prior law without commission order
headings.reviewNote: Declares securities issued after statutory effective date based on prior corporate action void without prior commission order.

headings.title: Retroactive commission approval for good faith security issues
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to retroactively approve unauthorized securities issued in good faith for statutory purposes without knowledge of requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 7 subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5678 through A.L. 1995 S.B. 3). Confirmed all 7 draft titles for proceeds accounting/§ 536.024 rules, void issues, $500–$20k penalties, felony penalties, no state guarantee, and good-faith retroactive approval.

headings.title: Commission supervision and authorization for corporate reorganizations
headings.reviewNote: Subjects telecommunications company reorganizations to commission supervision, control, and mandatory authorization.

headings.title: Capitalization limits, fair value, and reorganization agreements
headings.reviewNote: Limits reorganization capitalization to fair value of property and cash paid, requiring agreement amendments to conform with authorized amounts.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (RSMo 1939 § 5681, A.L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed draft titles for commission reorganization supervision and fair-value capitalization limits.

headings.title: Petition for competitive or transitionally competitive classification
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes telecommunications companies, including price-cap regulated carriers, to petition for competitive or transitionally competitive classification.

headings.title: Notice, hearing, and nine-month determination timeline
headings.reviewNote: Requires regular-mail notice to certified carriers, opportunity to be heard, consideration of relevant factors, and written findings within 9 months; source text contains 'subsection l' (letter l for numeral 1).

headings.title: Classification of company based on majority competitive services
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes classifying an entire company as competitive upon finding that a majority of its offered services are competitive.

headings.title: Classification orders for services and companies
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to classify services or companies as competitive or transitionally competitive upon finding sufficient competition.

headings.title: Suspension or modification of statutory rules and requirements
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission in classification orders to suspend or modify rules or statutory requirements in sections 392.200 to 392.340.

headings.title: Conditions on statutory suspensions and exchange access rate caps
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes protective conditions and caps competitive company exchange access rates at levels charged upon classification.

headings.title: Two-year limitation and consolidation of classification petitions
headings.reviewNote: Restricts classification petitions to once every two years absent exceptional circumstances, requiring consolidation of offered services.

headings.title: Statewide competitive classification for operator and directory services
headings.reviewNote: Deems intrastate operator and directory assistance services competitive on a statewide basis for all local exchange companies.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 8 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360, A.L. 1993 S.B. 160, A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779). Confirmed all 8 draft titles for competitive classification petitions, 9-month review (noting source typo 'subsection l' in sub 2), rule suspensions, and operator/directory services.

headings.title: Full applicability of regulatory statutes to noncompetitive carriers
headings.reviewNote: Provides that chapter 386 and sections 392.010 to 392.360 fully apply to noncompetitive telecommunications companies and services.

headings.title: Applicability of statutes to competitive carriers absent specific modification
headings.reviewNote: Specifies that chapter 386 and general provisions apply to competitive services and companies except as modified by sections 392.361 to 392.530.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed draft titles for applicability of ch. 386 and §§ 392.010–392.360 to noncompetitive and competitive/transitionally competitive companies.

headings.title: Prohibition against cross-subsidization of competitive services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits setting noncompetitive rates that recover expenses, investments, risks, or capital costs of competitive or transitionally competitive services.

headings.title: Prescription of accounting procedures to prevent cross-subsidies
headings.reviewNote: Mandates commission rules and accounting procedures to enforce prohibition against cross-subsidization by noncompetitive utilities.

headings.title: Cost calculation methods and mandatory cost studies
headings.reviewNote: Directs commission to establish cost calculation methods and authorizes ordering cost studies, permitting proprietary treatment.

headings.title: Offsetting noncompetitive rates with net competitive revenues
headings.reviewNote: Permits considering aggregate net competitive revenues above costs and return to offset noncompetitive rates, subject to utility withdrawal rights.

headings.title: Prohibition against predatory below-cost pricing
headings.reviewNote: Declares offering competitive or transitionally competitive services below cost unlawful when inconsistent with full and fair competition.

headings.title: Competitor complaints and preservation of antitrust laws
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes rate complaints by competitors and preserves causes of action and defenses under federal, state, and local antitrust laws.

headings.title: Inspection of books and records of companies and affiliates
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to examine records of companies and affiliates, shielding carriers from sanctions for auditor workpapers beyond control.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 7 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360). Confirmed all 7 draft titles covering cross-subsidization bans, accounting/cost studies, net revenue offsets, below-cost pricing, competitor complaints/antitrust preservation, and affiliate record inspection.

headings.title: Service certificate application requirements and grandfathered carriers
headings.reviewNote: Required certificate applications within ninety days of enactment, exempting 1913 pre-chartered companies and temporarily grandfathering existing providers.

headings.title: Separate certificates for interexchange and local exchange services
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits providing interexchange or local exchange service without obtaining specific certificate of service authority.

headings.title: Nonexclusive nature of certificates of service authority
headings.reviewNote: Declares certificates nonexclusive and establishes that issuance does not preclude granting additional certificates in same area.

headings.title: Preservation of prior certificates and requirement for expanded authority
headings.reviewNote: Preserves certificates granted prior to September 28, 1987, requiring new applications before substantially expanding service scope.

headings.title: Review, modification, and one-year expiration for non-exercise
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to modify certificates upon motion or application, voiding certificates not exercised within one year of issuance.

headings.title: Temporary certificates of service authority
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes issuance of temporary certificates up to one year without notice and hearing to maintain service or serve particular customers.

headings.title: Prohibition against political subdivisions providing retail telecommunications
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits political subdivisions from selling retail telecommunications while allowing right-of-way leasing, internal use, 911, medical/educational, and internet-type services; source note cites Nixon v. Missouri Municipal League, 541 U.S. 125 (2004).

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 7 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360 through A.L. 2008 H.B. 1426; Nixon v. Missouri Municipal League, 541 U.S. 125 (2004)). Confirmed all 7 draft titles and added Supreme Court annotation to sub 7 note.

headings.title: Mandatory disclosure of call location in emergency situations
headings.reviewNote: Requires telecommunications carriers and mobile providers to provide call location data to law enforcement in emergency situations without delay.

headings.title: Immunity from civil liability for emergency assistance
headings.reviewNote: Shields communications providers and personnel from civil liability for emergency location assistance, §§ 190.300–190.340 systems, and emergency service disruptions (except gross negligence, recklessness, or intentional misconduct in sub (3)).

headings.title: Voluntary disclosure protocols permitted
headings.reviewNote: Clarifies that section does not prohibit carriers and providers from establishing protocols for voluntary disclosure of location information.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 2012 H.B. 1108, A.L. 2013 H.B. 331, A.L. 2014 S.B. 651). Confirmed draft titles for emergency call location disclosure, civil immunity (refined sub 2 note), and voluntary protocols.

headings.title: Approval standard for local exchange and resale certificates
headings.reviewNote: Requires applicant showing and commission finding of compliance with section 392.455 certification process after notice and hearing.

headings.title: Universal service rules, tariffs, and minimum service standards
headings.reviewNote: Directs adoption of rules requiring applicants to file tariffs and meet minimum service standards comparable to incumbent providers.

headings.title: Statewide expansion for existing alternative local exchange carriers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes alternative carriers certified before August 28, 2008 to expand certificates statewide within thirty days if in good standing.

headings.title: Preservation of federal interconnection rights and commission authority
headings.reviewNote: Preserves federal interconnection and unbundling rights under 47 U.S.C. 251-252 and commission arbitration and mediation authority.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360, A.L. 1996 S.B. 507, A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779). Confirmed all 4 draft titles for local exchange certificates, universal service rules, statewide CLEC expansion, and federal 47 U.S.C. §§ 251–252 preservation.

headings.title: Definitions for carrier of last resort relief provisions
headings.reviewNote: Defines alternative service provider, greenfield area, local voice service, owner or developer, and real property.

headings.title: Commission approval required to abandon basic local service
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits abandoning basic service authorized as of January 1, 1984 without commission finding that customers will not be deprived of service.

headings.title: Automatic relief from carrier of last resort in greenfield areas
headings.reviewNote: Relieves carrier of last resort obligations where developer excludes incumbent, accepts exclusivity incentives, or charges mandatory fees.

headings.title: Notice to commission of carrier of last resort relief
headings.reviewNote: Requires local exchange carrier relieved under subsection 3 to notify commission in writing within 120 days of obtaining knowledge.

headings.title: Petition for waiver of carrier of last resort obligations
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes carrier to petition commission for waiver of last resort obligation for good cause based on property facts, with 90-day timeline.

headings.title: Owner or developer disclosure duties upon carrier relief
headings.reviewNote: Requires property owner or developer to notify occupants and subsequent buyers of incumbent relief and provider and technology details.

headings.title: Reassumption of carrier of last resort obligations upon condition cessation
headings.reviewNote: Governs reassumption of last resort obligation upon developer or resident petition when exclusive conditions cease, authorizing cost-recovery fees.

headings.title: Greenfield capability requirement for alternative service providers
headings.reviewNote: Provides carrier is not automatically excused in greenfield area unless alternative provider possesses local voice capability.

headings.title: Notice to purchasers of carrier exclusion
headings.reviewNote: Requires developer who excludes incumbent carrier to provide written notice of exclusivity to prospective real property purchasers.

headings.title: Right to advance payment for uneconomic multi-tenant extensions
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes incumbent to require tariffed advance payment from owner or developer when extending facilities to multi-tenant property is uneconomic.

headings.title: Use of any technology to satisfy service obligations and E911 standards
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes carriers to fulfill service obligations using any technology, requiring wireless technologies to meet FCC Phase II E911 standards.

headings.title: Preservation of broader carrier of last resort status outside relieved areas
headings.reviewNote: Provides that relief in specific areas does not forfeit carrier's general carrier of last resort designation under section 392.248.5.

headings.title: Non-transferability of carrier of last resort obligation to alternative providers
headings.reviewNote: Prohibits transferring carrier of last resort obligations to alternative providers or interconnected VoIP providers in relieved areas.

headings.title: Opt-out election for large charter counties and populous cities
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes carriers upon notice to commission to elect out of carrier of last resort status in specified large charter counties and populous cities; Revisor's Note flags county population description inconsistency under § 1.100.

headings.title: Ineligibility for state high-cost universal service funds in relieved areas
headings.reviewNote: Bars high-cost universal service funding for areas where carrier is relieved of last resort duties, preserving funding in retained areas.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 15 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360, A.L. 2011 H.B. 339; Revisor's Note on county description inconsistency under § 1.100 in sub 14). Confirmed all 15 draft titles and added Revisor's Note to sub 14 note.

headings.title: Commission conditions and compensation for unauthorized service
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to impose reasonable conditions and order just and reasonable compensation to certificated carriers for unauthorized intrastate service (intentional, unintentional, or incidental). Clarified ambiguous 'unauthorized compensation' phrasing.

headings.title: Judicial enforcement and venue for compensation orders
headings.reviewNote: Provides that compensation orders are enforced by circuit courts, placing venue in any county where unauthorized service occurred.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360). Clarified sub 1 title ('unauthorized compensation' -> 'compensation for unauthorized service') and confirmed sub 2 circuit court enforcement and venue.

headings.title: Filing of banded rate tariffs for competitive services
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes companies to file banded rate tariffs with maximum and minimum rates for competitive or transitionally competitive services.

headings.title: Approval standards and modification of transitionally competitive bands
headings.reviewNote: Permits approval of transitionally competitive bands found in public interest, empowering commission to modify band limits.

headings.title: Exemption from statutory rate notice and ten-day notice requirement
headings.reviewNote: Exempts rate changes within approved bands from general filing requirements, requiring written notice within ten days of effective date.

headings.title: Grandfathering of rate bands approved prior to September 28, 1987
headings.reviewNote: Deems previously approved rate bands valid and exempts intra-band rate adjustments from statutory notice requirements.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360, A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779). Confirmed all 4 draft titles for banded rate tariffs, transitionally competitive approval, 10-day post-change notice, and pre-Sept. 28, 1987 grandfathering.

headings.title: Jurisdiction and minimum regulation of private shared and payphone services
headings.reviewNote: Establishes jurisdiction over private shared tenant and customer-owned coin telephone services under minimum competitive regulation and tariff exemptions.

headings.title: Local network access charges and alternative tenant access requirement
headings.reviewNote: Empowers commission to set connection rates and require shared tenant providers to offer alternative local access if no alternative exists.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified both subsections and source notes (L. 1987 H.B. 360, A.L. 2008 H.B. 1779). Confirmed draft titles for minimum regulation of private shared tenant/payphone services and local access charges/alternative tenant access.

headings.title: Registration requirement for interconnected VoIP service providers
headings.reviewNote: Requires providers of interconnected voice over internet protocol service to obtain registration from the commission.

headings.title: Applicability of exchange access charges and existing interconnection agreements
headings.reviewNote: Subjects interconnected VoIP service to exchange access charges, preserving existing intercarrier compensation agreements through 2009.

headings.title: Registration application procedures, required affidavit, and annual reporting
headings.reviewNote: Directs registration within thirty days upon affidavit verifying qualification, fee collection, commission assessment, and dispute processes.

headings.title: Commission regulatory authority over interconnected VoIP providers
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes commission to collect program fees, universal service assessments, resolve access charge disputes, and suspend registrations.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (L. 2008 H.B. 1779). Confirmed all 4 draft titles for interconnected VoIP registration, access charges/pre-2010 interconnection agreements, 30-day affidavit registration/annual reports, and commission authority.

headings.title: Annual six percent reduction of intrastate switched exchange access rates
headings.reviewNote: Mandated three annual 6% access rate reductions toward interstate levels, exempting small incumbents under 25,000 lines and rural CLECs.

headings.title: Definition and qualification criteria for rural alternative local exchange carriers
headings.reviewNote: Defines rural alternative local exchange telecommunications companies based on certification, tariffs, 60% loop ownership, and 90% third-class county lines.

headings.title: Geographic limitation of exemption to existing exchanges
headings.reviewNote: Restricts rural alternative local exchange carrier exemption to exchanges where lines were served as of December 31, 2009.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 3 subsections and source notes (L. 2010 H.B. 1750). Confirmed all 3 draft titles for 2011–2013 annual 6% switched access reductions, rural CLEC criteria, and Dec. 31, 2009 exchange limitation.

headings.title: Exemption of retail services from regulation and retained statutory duties
headings.reviewNote: Exempts retail services from ch. 386 and ch. 392 regulation unless carrier elects otherwise, while retaining USF surcharges, revenue reporting, and § 392.415 emergency location duties; footnote notes 'chapters' appears in original rolls.

headings.title: Exemption of broadband and internet protocol-enabled services
headings.reviewNote: Exempts broadband and IP-enabled services from regulation, retaining VoIP registration requirements under section 392.550.

headings.title: Preservation of federal delegated authority and intercarrier interconnection
headings.reviewNote: Preserves commission authority under federal delegations and federal and state law regarding interconnection, intercarrier compensation, and number pooling.

headings.title: Alternative registration process for obtaining telecommunications certification
headings.reviewNote: Authorizes telecommunications companies seeking certification after August 28, 2014 to utilize VoIP registration process under section 392.550.3.

entries.reviewSummary: Independently verified all 4 subsections and source notes (L. 2013 H.B. 331, A.L. 2014 S.B. 651; original-rolls footnote 'chapters' in sub 1). Confirmed all 4 draft titles and added original-rolls footnote to sub 1 note.
